delivery.en: Parcels: a safe place, the porch, a neighbour, or an An Post pickup point
delivery.zh: 包裹放安全處、門廊、交給鄰居，或到 An Post 點取

readback.en: 08 mobiles use oh and double; amounts in euro; say Eircode; half two is 2:30
readback.zh: 手機用 oh、double 唸；金額用歐元與 Eircode；half two＝2:30

fraud.en: A fake Revenue threat, an An Post fee link, or a courier collecting your card, are scams
fraud.zh: 冒充稅務局 Revenue 威脅、假 An Post 要補費，或派人收卡的都是詐騙

habits.en: Irish English. Say mobile, Eircode, flat; not cell, zip or HMRC. Dates go day first.
habits.zh: 用愛爾蘭英語。說 mobile、Eircode、flat，不說 cell、zip、HMRC。日期先日後月。

stall_local.en: Get stuck on the banking app spinning, glasses upstairs, a missing card reader, or a lost Eircode.
stall_local.zh: 卡在銀行 App 一直轉、眼鏡在樓上、找不到讀卡機或 Eircode 信件。

reason.en: UK tax authority; Ireland's is Revenue
reason.zh: 英國稅務機關，愛爾蘭是 Revenue

reason.en: UK transfer scheme; Ireland typically uses SEPA and IBAN
reason.zh: 英國轉帳機制，愛爾蘭日常多用 SEPA、IBAN

talk_style_diff.en: Warmer Irish English, often with grand. Tax talk is Revenue, not HMRC; money is in euro and postcodes are Eircodes. Formality range otherwise stays close.
talk_style_diff.zh: 愛爾蘭英語更暖，常說 grand。稅務是 Revenue 不是 HMRC；用歐元和 Eircode。親疏層級仍相近。

uncertain: 愛爾蘭帳戶歷史上仍有 sort code，但日常轉帳更常報 IBAN；兩者並用的比例未再深查。
